parole.testo: Rix suggests a derivation from Proto-Indo-European *molh₃-éye-ti, a causative from the root *melh₃-, making it a cognate of Ancient Greek βλώσκω (blṓskō), and possibly Latin multus.
From Proto-Indo-European *wékʷ-ti, from *wekʷ- (“to speak”). Cognate with Russian вякать (vjakatʹ), Sanskrit वक्ति (vakti).
